cells.gaps: Inside the 36 months no row gives a current plan naming the system or a domestic budget line: the only plan rows date from 2020 (DJI-016, DJI-020) and the only finance row is UNFPA's support for one integration (DJI-008). The 84% is of all facilities with no numerator or denominator, the tier row names the primary care level only, and nothing is dated inside the twelve months to the as-at (the 69% to 84% rise ends 2025-06-30); the 2020 tier rows (DJI-017 T2;T3, DJI-022 none) disagree with the 2025 one, which stands.
cells.note: Coverage reaches stage 4: the primary tier, entry at the facility, 84% of facilities at 30 June 2025, short of stage 5's 90%. Governance holds the ministry as owner but neither a current plan nor domestic finance within 36 months, so the cap holds it at 3.

cells.gaps: Two rows, neither able to set a rung: DJI-003 is from the excluded compilation, and DJI-014 is a general 2024 statement of paper follow-up that names no tier and no system. No row names an EMR at any tier, and none states that patient records are on paper at every tier.
cells.note: Stage 1 needs a dated statement of paper records at every tier, and DJI-014 names no tier. Stage 2 needs a hospital, pilot or procured EMR, and the only patient-level system held is a family-planning record, a tracker.
